setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 has two patterns assigned in an eight-step loop. Pattern 1 plays four notes (C, D, E, F on steps 1 to 4) and is saved as its Anchor; pattern 2 plays MIDI 60 on steps 5 and 7. Merge strategy is Skip, the default. Channel 2 has no anchor. Merge modes is open for channel 1. Terms used below: Strategy is the choice you make with E3 or grid key (14,8); Active is the strategy that is playing now; Pending is a choice waiting for its boundary and Boundary says when it will apply; Request says whether a choice was accepted, for example NEEDS ANCHOR.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Select Strategy with E2 and turn E3 right until it reads FOUNDATION (grid key (14,8) steps through the same choices). Select Active: it reads FOUNDATION. The first pattern stays whole and the second only adds notes.
steps.title: Keep the foundation, add the other pattern

steps.caption: Tap Play (1,8) for two eight-step loops. The four anchor notes keep their velocities; MIDI 60 is added on steps 5 and 7 at velocity 70.
steps.title: Hear quieter additions

steps.caption: Under Foundation, Note, Velocity and Length modes still edit. Select each on Merge modes and turn E3 right to read UP, then left to read AVERAGE again.
steps.title: Numeric modes still edit

steps.caption: Press (14,8) again: Strategy reads FRAGMENTS.
steps.title: Press the key again

steps.caption: Strategy and Active read FRAGMENTS and (14,8) is at its brightest. The saved Note, Velocity and Length merge settings show AVERAGE SAVED; turning E3 on them changes nothing while Fragments is active.
steps.title: Saved modes are locked

steps.caption: With Size 8 and Seed 0 the loop takes pattern 2 whole: tap Play to hear MIDI 60 on steps 5 and 7 at velocity 100, the source's own velocity.
steps.title: Hear one source fragment

steps.caption: Press (14,8): Strategy wraps from FRAGMENTS round to SKIP and the key dims to its lowest level.
steps.title: Wrap to Skip

steps.caption: Select Note, Velocity and Length mode: the saved settings return as editable AVERAGE. Strategy order: Skip, Only, All, Foundation, Fragments; E3 stops at the ends but the grid key wraps.
steps.title: Return to the retained modes

steps.caption: Press (14,8) to choose ONLY. Only steps used by both patterns sound, and these patterns share none, so the grid shows no sounding trigs and Play gives no notes.
steps.title: Hear only the shared attacks

steps.caption: Press (14,8) once more to choose ALL, then press Play (1,8) for two loops and Play again to stop. With ALL, every attack of both patterns sounds: six in all. The added notes at steps 5 and 7 now use their source velocity, 100, not Foundation's 70.
steps.title: Compare the original additions

steps.caption: Select channel 2 and open Merge Shape > Rhythm. Anchor reads NONE: this channel has no foundation pattern saved.
steps.title: Channel two has no anchor

steps.caption: Assign patterns 1 and 2 to channel 2, open Merge modes, set Strategy to ALL and turn E3 right once to request Foundation. Turn E2 down the list to Request: it reads NEEDS ANCHOR, because channel 2 has no anchor pattern saved. Active stays ALL and Pending stays NONE.
steps.title: Read Request - NEEDS ANCHOR

steps.caption: Turn E2 back up to Strategy. It shows FOUNDATION while the footer reads NEEDS ANCHOR and Active is still ALL, so the refused choice stays visible but nothing changes in what plays.
steps.title: Recognise a missing anchor

steps.caption: Press (14,8) again: Strategy moves on to FRAGMENTS, so a refused request does not trap the key.
steps.title: The key still moves on

steps.caption: Turn E3 left until Strategy reads ALL again on channel 2.
steps.title: Set channel 2 back to ALL

steps.caption: Tap pattern slots 1 and 2 at (1,2) and (2,2) to take both patterns off channel 2, press Channel (3,8) and select channel 1 at (1,1). Open Channel tasks > Merge Shape > Rhythm: Anchor reads 1.
steps.title: Back to channel one

steps.caption: On the Channel editor toggle pattern slot 2 off and on, then remove pattern slot 1, the anchor pattern. Back on Merge modes turn E3 right once and turn E2 down to Request: Foundation is refused in the same way and Request reads NEEDS ANCHOR again. Active stays ALL.
steps.title: Read Request - NEEDS ANCHOR again

steps.caption: Turn E2 back up to Strategy: it shows FOUNDATION and the footer reads NEEDS ANCHOR. Assign the anchor pattern again to recover.
steps.title: Keep the assigned source explicit

steps.caption: Press (14,8): Strategy moves on to FRAGMENTS. Tap pattern slot 1 at (1,2) to assign the anchor pattern again, then select Strategy and turn E3 left to ALL.
steps.title: Return to ALL with the anchor back

steps.caption: Check Strategy still reads ALL, press Play (1,8), then turn E3 right once to request Foundation while ALL is playing. Turn E2 down to Pending: it reads FOUNDATION, the choice waiting for its boundary.
steps.title: Read Pending - FOUNDATION

steps.caption: Turn E2 further down to Boundary, which reads NEXT CYCLE. The current loop keeps playing ALL until it ends.
steps.title: Request a change during playback

steps.caption: Listen across the loop boundary. The first loop still uses the source velocity 100 on the added notes; the next complete loop plays Foundation's velocity 70. Playback never stops for the change.
steps.title: Hear the change at the loop boundary

steps.caption: Open Merge Shape from Channel tasks. It shows the accepted Strategy as a read-only summary; turning E3 there does not choose another strategy. Choose strategies with (14,8) or on Merge modes.
steps.title: Find the single Strategy selector

steps.caption: Turn E2 to Rhythm, select Add amount and turn E3 left: it reads an unapplied 99.
steps.title: Edit Add amount without applying

steps.caption: Press K2 to leave without applying, open the Strategy selector and return to Rhythm. The accepted Add amount is still 100: an unapplied draft is discarded.
steps.title: Discard the parameter draft before selecting Strategy
